QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] The Master's Heart
QuestInfo.0: Eremos is heartbroken over Surana's departure. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos clearly regrets his outburst at Surana, but he doesn't have the courage to find her and apologize. For all his knowledge about the universe  and life, he is at a loss as to how to rectify the situation.
